Howie's life and legacy live on through his loved ones' advocacy to promote the importance of mental health care for law enforcement.

I've been proud to work alongside them to rename the USCP wellness center in his honor and expand counseling services available to officers.

"The actions of the athletes, companies and international orgs at the 2022 Beijing Olympics will be remembered for generations, as they were after the Games in 1936. Each of them—and each of us—must think hard about which side of history we want to be on."
https://t.co/mmifm08HUT

Virginia families have seen major savings thanks to subsidies we passed in the American Rescue Plan, and a record number of people are signing up for coverage.

Thanks to our work in Congress, health care is more affordable and accessible than ever.
https://t.co/OFN3Jl4pOD

Today I was proud to vote to expand VA health care coverage to over 3.5 million veterans who were exposed to toxic substances including burn pits while serving our country.

We have a responsibility to do all that's in our power to care for our veterans when they return home. https://t.co/lr46bBUyQW

March is #NationalNutritionMonth, so I visited @TylerTomcats on Friday to discuss their outstanding school nutrition program, which strives to source foods locally and has done remarkable work to feed families during COVID—made possible by programs I supported in Congress. https://t.co/EuNpq1BNqa

12 years ago, @BarackObama signed the ACA, which expanded access to health care for millions of Virginians and guaranteed protections for those with pre-existing conditions.

I'm proud that we've further lowered premiums & expanded access to care through the American Rescue Plan. https://t.co/gM0i8BIR72

In the wake of January 6th, @AppropsDems have delivered robust funding to support Capitol security and USCP staff retention and well-being.

I’m committed to ensuring our officers have the support they need at our newly established Howie Liebengood Center for Wellness. https://t.co/9AoCfXwnFf

No one in America should sacrifice the care they need because they can’t afford the costs.

Today the House took an important step to cap the cost of insulin at $35 a month—which would save families hundreds of dollars on average each year.
https://t.co/z7qnpW0RKK

This action by @POTUS will make quality health insurance plans more affordable and accessible to millions of Americans.

It builds on our work through the American Rescue Plan to bring premiums to an all-time low and expand enrollment to an all-time high.
https://t.co/PLyoJF9VSy

USCP officers work 24/7 to keep the Capitol community safe, & I’ve been working hard in Congress to have their back.

I’m proud to have secured funding to create the Howie C. Liebengood Center for Wellness that is providing the mental health & other support our officers deserve.

Great news for Virginia schools!

@USDA has announced a nearly $1 million grant to help our schools build & retain a strong nutrition workforce & bolster school meal services.

I'll keep working to deliver the federal resources our schools need to succeed.
https://t.co/JPZpq30Vz1 https://t.co/bgfNPfatrr

Big news—the national uninsured rate has hit an all-time low!

Thanks to our work to increase subsidies and expand access to care through our #AmericanRescuePlan, more families than ever can get the affordable health care they need.
https://t.co/I1nvGt5r1z

I support the #InflationReductionAct which will deliver on longstanding priorities to help #VA10 families like:

💊Empower Medicare to negotiate drug prices
♻️Deliver historic investments in clean energy to fight climate change
💰Ensure corporations pay their fair share in taxes

If you're able to donate blood, please consider signing up for an upcoming appointment.

It's safe and simple to do, and your help will go a long way for our local hospitals to care for those in need right now.

Learn more below ⬇️

NEW: Thanks to legislation I've supported in Congress, health care is more affordable and accessible than ever for Virginians.

Our #InflationReductionAct will save tens of thousands of #VA10 families money on health insurance and prescription drug costs.
https://t.co/JCoE6eJ213

For the first time in a decade, #VA10 seniors and those with disabilities will see cheaper Medicare Part B premiums!

I'm fighting to strengthen Medicare and lower health care costs—that's why I proudly supported the #InflationReductionAct to cap the cost of prescription drugs.

I fought to pass the Inflation Reduction Act which is helping 32,000 people in #VA10 access affordable health care coverage.

Thanks to subsidies we extended in this law, these Virginians are saving an average of $850/year on their insurance premiums. https://t.co/SyHV1q1NK9

Open enrollment begins today! If you're looking for an affordable health insurance plan or want to switch your coverage, head to https://t.co/QWzuJj2FsU.

#VA10 families can save an average of over $900 a year on premiums thanks to our Inflation Reduction Act.

#GetCovered today! https://t.co/U6oFfIgDHP

NEW: I led my colleagues in urging @GovernorVA to take additional action & prepare for Medicaid unwinding.

We must take steps now to alert impacted Virginians & coordinate w/providers to avoid the devastating consequences if families lose access to critical health care services. https://t.co/QAvU2mOerH

I'm concerned by the spike in RSV and flu cases among kids, and actions must be taken to ensure that our hospitals have the resources they need to keep our communities healthy.

I've joined @RepCohen in urging @POTUS to declare a pediatric health emergency.

Thanks to our #InflationReductionAct, Virginia seniors on Medicare now won’t pay more than $35 a month for their insulin.

No one should have to choose between lifesaving medication or putting food on the table.

I’m proud we’ve finally delivered on this longstanding priority. https://t.co/cviXuVCLGj

I'm in awe of Serena Liebengood's advocacy for greater police mental health resources after her husband, Officer Howie Liebengood, died by suicide following 1/6.

It's been an honor to work with her to establish the new @CapitolPolice health and wellness center in Howie's memory. https://t.co/dnAZz9LhKT

A record number of Americans have enrolled in an affordable health insurance plan for this year—and thanks to our work in Congress, your options are cheaper than ever.

There's still time to find coverage that works for your family. Visit https://t.co/wt5qIKPA49 today.

Seniors on Medicare are now paying only $35/month for insulin.

But House Republicans want to take us backwards—introducing legislation to repeal the sweeping provisions in our #InflationReductionAct which are lowering drug costs.

We can't let them win.
https://t.co/OmGgivLbGC

NEW: More than 36,400 Virginia Medicare beneficiaries are paying less for their insulin this year thanks to our #InflationReductionAct.

They're saving an average of $510 annually with the new $35/month cap—just one of the ways we've lowered health care costs for #VA10 families.
